title: Japanese-Style Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with fish fillets, quickly cooked vegetables, and a hint of portuguese spices.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Pour in the nimonoed broth and add the portuguese saffron.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a side of steamed rice.
